thread:
alex: Heads-up — legal asked for a change-history export that ties each change to a rollout snapshot + telemetry event id. They want a single downloadable bundle we can hand off.
maria: Do they need raw actor ids or pseudonymized?
alex: Raw for legal, but security insists on gated access + audit trail. We discussed presigned links + short-lived keys.
sam: +1 on presigned. Also we need to record the exact policy-version hash used to render the UI snapshot. Otherwise 'who changed what' becomes fuzzy.
joni: Can we embed a small provenance manifest in the bundle? e.g. 
```
{"manifest_version":"1","policy_hash":"sha256:...","telemetry_event":"evt_2023..","exported_by":"alex"}
```
alex: yes, exactly that. But where do we surface the telemetry_event id? in the console and in the export metadata?
maria: Console should show the id and a link to the telemetry trace. Export bundle should include the id and a minimal pointer (not the whole span). Legal can request the full trace via internal ops.
sam: A few infra constraints: presigned URLs need to respect quota tokens and entitlement checks. We can't just hand presigned links that bypass routing/quotas.
infra-bot: deploy queued: audit-export-service v1.3.2 -> staging (eta 5m) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
joni: Implementation idea — the export endpoint returns a signed manifest + S3 url short-lived, but the presigner validates the requesting user's entitlements and stamps the signed URL with an export_id. Then we stream an event to telemetry with export_id, actor, and policy_hash.
maria: For compliance, we also need to include an 'acceptance' step for privileged changes. If the export contains privileged-change records, require a two-person approval before download.
alex: How do we mark 'privileged' in the change events? We currently have change.reason + change.scope fields. Might need change.privilege_level enum.
sam: Adding a small enum is fine. Backwards compatible if default = "normal".
joni: UX question — do we show an export progress modal with estimated size and included actor count? customers asked for that.
maria: Yes but keep it opt-in for bulk exports ( >10k events ). For small exports, just instant link.
alex: Edge case: rollouts that interleave changes across tenants — export should partition by tenant and include cross-tenant mapping file.
sam: Also add a digest signature (server-side HMAC) for the bundle so downstream consumers can verify integrity.
joni: From API side, here's a proposed contract: POST /v1/audit/exports {"query":..., "include_provenance": true, "pseudonymize": false, "require_approval": true} -> 202 {"export_id":"exp_...","status":"pending_approval"}
maria: And a GET /v1/audit/exports/:id/status to poll. When ready, returns presigned_url and manifest.
alex: Need to ensure that presigned_url download checks still consult quota service — i.e., when link is used, we still tick export.download quota.
sam: That is doable if presigned url hits our presign gateway which logs usage and then redirects to S3 via signed token. Don't let direct S3 link out.
joni: Telemetry shape: {"export_id":"exp_..","actor":"alex","manifest":{"policy_hash":".."},"size_bytes":12345,"included_tenants":["t-123"],"privileged_count":3} — use that for later billing & audit.
maria: For legal requests, we should also capture chain-of-custody: who approved, when, and IP. That goes in the exported manifest and in telemetry.
alex: Security note: redact PII fields by default unless the requester has 'eDiscovery' entitlement. We need a clear UI warning when enabling raw ids.
sam: Ops note: let's rate-limit exports per-tenant and per-actor. Default 1 export/min for large ones. Add emergency override for SRE.
joni: I can prototype the frontend modal and the API stubs this week. Who wants to own the presign gateway changes?
alex: Sam will take presign gateway + quota integration. Maria will own approval workflow and UI copy. Joni builds modal and manifest format. I'll coordinate eDiscovery entitlements.
maria: Cool. I'll draft an approval schema and a short checklist for legal to sign off on.
alex: One more thing — we should version the manifest (manifest_version) and document in the console 'Export formats' page. Avoid future parsing pain.
sam: Agreed. I'll open the infra PR and tag y'all. :rocket:
